title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Jacaranda Glass. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Jacaranda Glass
options.lineage: Bangalore's jacaranda and gulmohar avenues, seen through thick frosted clinic glass
options.thesis: The whole site is morning light through clinic glass, and the booking card is the thickest pane.
options.viewport: Logo top-left over a jacaranda light field; a thick glass booking slab holds the nearest branch, open-now status and the next three slots as tappable chips; rating and founder etched on its edge; glass dock below.
options.risk: Glass over gradients is an AI-era cliché unless the light is specifically Bangalore's and the glass has real thickness and refraction.

raised.raise: One light grades every photo: clinic images are toned in the field's light so they never wash out on the bright ground.
Every element declares a depth (0-3) that sets its blur, shadow, tilt and parallax from one shared clock.
Slot states are marks, not colours: taken slots are struck through, your pick carries a flag, and an unfinished booking is re-flagged when you return.
The body map links both ways: a service lights every region it treats, a region lights its services.
Motion runs as one numbered sequence (field, slab, slots, dock), never scattered effects.
Text sits in fixed-measure courses: each band's line length is set once and every block obeys it.

options.label: Bannerghatta Line
options.lineage: Namma Metro and BMTC wayfinding along the Bannerghatta Road corridor
options.thesis: The three branches as stops on one line through South Bangalore, the next free slot shown like the next train.
options.viewport: A bold route line across the top with the three branches as station dots, the nearest ringed with its distance; a departure-board card lists the next free slots there; glass dock below.
options.risk: Wayfinding can read cold and transit-like, and signage grammar is a familiar, safe-feeling choice.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.lineage: a mirrored-ceiling hall lit by one monofrequency sun
options.thesis: The clinic as one amber hall where every colour flattens to a single light.
options.viewport: A vast amber band with a half sun and the booking slots as lying silhouettes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a dark amber hall fights the pinned light healthcare feel, and patients do not identify with it.
options.kept: Total light commitment: one light grades every photo.
options.risk: Reads as an art installation, not a clinic.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Rank is depth: the next slot is the brightest line in a drifting void.
options.viewport: One ivory line of bitmap text over a black void with drifting grey stars.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a black void and bitmap type contradict light, calm and readable for older patients.
options.kept: One depth scale drives blur, shadow, tilt and drift.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.lineage: film editors' work prints on pins
options.thesis: Booking steps as frames strung on a perforated rail.
options.viewport: An orange grain field crossed by a perforated rail of booking steps.
options.case: Fuses poorly: orange-on-black is the opposite of the pinned light look; the metaphor means nothing to patients.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue; where you stopped is flagged.

options.label: Desert Neon Sign
options.thesis: The three branches billed on one towering lit sign.
options.viewport: A night-ground sign stack with a chasing arrow pointing to Book.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a night ground and motel kitsch undercut medical trust.

options.label: Character Reference Sheet
options.thesis: The body map as a four-view reference sheet with named swatches.
options.viewport: Four views of a figure with a swatch row under it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: clashing fills and hand lettering read amateur for a clinic; it only helps the body map.
options.kept: Two-way linking between swatch and region.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: Recovery built course by course, like a coiled clay wall.
options.viewport: Stacked terracotta bands with the slots set as courses.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an earthen terracotta world contradicts light and clinical, and lands in the cream-terracotta default.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean clinic website, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero with a headline and a Book button, service cards below, reviews carousel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other clinic by design.
